raw_text:
KARAN MALHOTRA

+91 99887 55432 | karan.content@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/karanmalhotra-content | portfolio.com/karan | Mumbai, Maharashtra
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Content Creator specializing in content marketing, social media storytelling, audience engagement, influencer collaborations, and brand growth. Strong experience creating compelling content that drives reach, engagement, and conversions.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Business Administration (2021–2025)
NMIMS Mumbai
CGPA: 9.3/10
Relevant Coursework: Marketing Management, Digital Branding, Consumer Psychology, Media Studies
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Content Skills: Copywriting, Script Writing, Content Strategy, SEO
Platforms: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest
Tools: Canva, Adobe Photoshop, CapCut, Google Analytics
Marketing: Influencer Marketing, Campaign Management, Community Building
EXPERIENCE
Content Marketing Intern — BrightWave Digital (Feb 2025 – Present)
• Planned and executed content campaigns generating 1M+ impressions.
• Increased engagement rates by 48%.
• Coordinated influencer partnerships and brand collaborations.

Social Content Intern — MediaBoost Studios (Jun 2024 – Dec 2024)
• Created social media content calendars and campaigns.
• Conducted audience research and performance analysis.
PROJECTS
Brand Awareness Campaign | Social Media Marketing
• Generated 2M+ organic impressions across platforms.

LinkedIn Personal Branding Project
• Built professional audience exceeding 15,000 followers.

Video Content Strategy Project | Analytics & Storytelling
• Improved audience retention and engagement metrics significantly.
CERTIFICATIONS
Meta Social Media Marketing Certification
HubSpot Content Marketing Certification
Google Fundamentals of Digital Marketing
ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS
Winner, National Digital Content Competition.
Top Creator Award at College Media Fest.
Merit Scholarship Recipient.
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
Marketing Society Core Member.
Produced content for college campaigns and events.
Freelance content strategist for startups and creators.
